I can't make you surrender, but please do.
The irony is that Iran's Navy and Air Force were barely functional before the war started. Most of the aircraft hit on the ground weren't operational anyway, they were old airframes sitting in storage or being cannibalized for parts.
Iran is still operating F-4s and F-5s, as well as locally produced versions like the Saeqeh and Kowsar built by HESA, and none of them were destroyed. As for the navy, their doctrine is clear: they don’t focus on a traditional blue-water fleet. Instead, they rely on fast attack craft and coastal defense systems to operate close to shore.
